confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Nafplio's summer tourist pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident; accommodation and drinks are less certain and depend on season and location. FX: I could not retrieve a verifiable official RBA observation. Two searches returned only third-party figures and RBA page titles without a readable rate, so the fx fields are null rather than filled with unverified values. The fx block must be populated from an rba.gov.au table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Greek mainland and coastal tourist towns in peak season, such as Kalamata and Rethymno, adjusted for Nafplio's strong seasonal demand. Price points assume euro-based pricing converted at an approximate EUR/USD of 1.15.
